description: This file contains extension methods for IServiceCollection to configure and manage IOptionFormatter and related services for options in the Orleans framework. It provides methods for setting up formatters, resolvers, and named options for logging purposes.

classes.name: OptionConfigureExtensionMethods
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for IServiceCollection to configure option formatters, resolvers, and logging options.

methods.name: ConfigureFormatter
methods.description: Configures an IOptionFormatter for a specific options type TOptions and formatter TOptionFormatter.

methods.name: ConfigureFormatter<TOptions>
methods.description: Sets up a default formatter for options of type TOptions.

methods.name: TryConfigureFormatter
methods.description: Configures an IOptionFormatter for TOptions if none is already configured.

methods.name: ConfigureFormatterResolver
methods.description: Configures a formatter resolver for TOptions.

methods.name: TryConfigureFormatterResolver
methods.description: Sets up a resolver for TOptions if none is already configured.

methods.name: ConfigureNamedOptionForLogging
methods.description: Configures an IOptionFormatter for a named options object, primarily for logging purposes.
